text: The accel_step margin rises smoothly at N=256 and levels off at 0.15-0.18. At the 0.1 bar, formation falls at steps 100-120, but at 0.15 it spans steps 150-240. With matched seeds and best-of-5 controls at N=64 and N=256, does the ordering of formation steps across steps_per_orbit depend on the threshold? Would comparing the step where each run reaches half its own final margin give a threshold-free measure of timing?
